Nordic Emergency Solutions ApS

Emergency response, CPR and conversation training in VR and with AI — clinical precision when it matters.

We build training platforms in VR and with AI that let you train decisions, teamwork, difficult conversations and life-saving action again and again — in realistic scenarios, without risk, and without compromising clinical accuracy.

Contact

Solutions

Nordic Emergency Solutions develops three training platforms – two in VR and one for difficult conversations with an AI character – all built around the same core idea: the best decisions in a crisis are the ones you've already practised. Whether it's a full-scale multi-agency emergency exercise, resuscitating an unconscious patient or the conversation with a relative in shock, our platforms give you a safe space to practise, fail and improve — again and again.

Disaster & Emergency Response Training

A multi-user VR simulation where fire services, police, authorities and rescue services train together in the same scenario — each from their own perspective. A gamemaster runs it in real time and can add complications or escalate the pressure, just like in a real crisis. The focus is the cross-agency coordination that determines whether a response succeeds.

  • Several participants in the same scenario, at once
  • A gamemaster adapts the scenario in real time
  • Trains coordination across agencies
  • Repeatable training without risk or logistics
Download brochure (PDF, Danish)

First Aid & CPR Training

A VR simulation of first aid and CPR, built on recognised clinical guidelines. You practise chest compressions, AED use and the critical first minutes, where correct technique makes the difference between life and death. The focus is repeating the scenario until the response becomes second nature.

  • Built on recognised clinical guidelines
  • Practise chest compressions and AED use
  • Repeat until the response becomes automatic
  • Train whenever it suits you — no logistics
Download brochure (PDF, Danish)

vis-à-vis – difficult conversationsBeta

An AI simulation of difficult conversations, where you talk face to face with a worried patient, a relative in shock or a citizen in crisis. The conversation takes place as a live video call or a phone call and is then evaluated against the case's professional criteria. The focus is concrete feedback and focus points for the next conversation.

  • Video or phone conversation with an AI character
  • Cases grounded in professional frameworks
  • Score, feedback and focus points every time
  • Your own users, single sign-on and branding
Read more about vis-à-vis

Academy

Academy is for those who want to lead the training themselves. We train gamemasters who can run and adapt the multi-user scenarios behind our emergency response platform, and CPR instructors who can facilitate realistic first-aid training for others. You get both the clinical grounding and the instructional skills to make the training credible — whether it takes place at a fire station, a hospital, or a workplace.

Labs

Labs is our internal R&D environment — where new VR concepts, scenarios and technologies are developed, tested and challenged long before they reach users. We work closely with clinicians, educators and gamemasters to understand how didactic learning principles best translate from a virtual experience into an action you can rely on in reality.
